# In one function, the zero fill stays as written and the non-zero fill is rewritten.

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp ops_simd.go ops_simd.go.want
cmp ops.go ops.go.guarded

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func Mixed(a, b []float64) {
	for i := range a {
		a[i] = 0
	}
	for i := range b {
		b[i] = 1
	}
}
-- ops_simd.go.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package test

import "simd"

func Mixed(a, b []float64) {
	for i := range a {
		a[i] = 0
	}
	_vcFloat64s0 := simd.BroadcastFloat64s(1)
	{
		_w1 := b[:len(b):len(b)]
		_count := len(_w1)
		_i, _lanes := 0, simd.BroadcastFloat64s(0).Len()
		for ; _i <= _count-4*_lanes; _i += 4 * _lanes {
			_c1 := _w1[_i:][:4*_lanes]
			_vcFloat64s0.Store(_c1)
			_vcFloat64s0.Store(_c1[_lanes:])
			_vcFloat64s0.Store(_c1[2*_lanes:])
			_vcFloat64s0.Store(_c1[3*_lanes:])
		}
		for ; _i <= _count-_lanes; _i += _lanes {
			_vcFloat64s0.Store(_w1[_i:])
		}
		for _i < _count {
			_n := _vcFloat64s0.StorePart(_w1[_i:])
			_i += _n
		}
	}
}
-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 1 loop(s) in $WORK/ops.go
-- ops.go.guarded --
//go:build !goexperiment.simd

package test

func Mixed(a, b []float64) {
	for i := range a {
		a[i] = 0
	}
	for i := range b {
		b[i] = 1
	}
}
